description.value:
You choose a point on the ground you can see within range, and the earth erupts in a 20-foot cube around it. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d12 kinetic damage, half as much on a success. The affected ground also becomes difficult terrain, requiring at least 1 minute of manual labor to clear each 5-foot square.

Cast with a slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level beyond 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 3
